comparison.objective: Wrap a blind cord on a high wall cleat; candidate adjusts and validates an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-cord routing and wrapping differ from rigid hex-key insertion, collar adjustment, counterholding, and setscrew tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires the cord secured high and out of child reach, but the record omits wrap count, height, retention, and release criteria; candidate uses quantified impact tests.
comparison.reason: Deformable cord management is clearly different from damper commissioning.
